hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Europe, bordering the Black Sea, between Romania and Turkey || mostly mountains with lowlands in north and southeast || strategic location near Turkish Straits; controls key land routes from Europe to Middle East and Asia || Resources: bauxite, copper, lead, zinc, coal, timber, arable land || Exports: refined petroleum, garments, refined copper, wheat, natural gas (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly mountains with lowlands in north and southeast || Southeastern Europe, bordering the Black Sea, between Romania and Turkey

climate.excerpt: temperate; cold, damp winters; hot, dry summers || earthquakes; landslides

economy.excerpt: upper-middle-income EU economy; currency pegged to the euro, with eurozone accession pending; declining energy prices helping lower inflation rate; EU structural funds contributing to investment recovery; skilled labor shortage driven by emigration and aging population || Exports: refined petroleum, garments, refined copper, wheat, natural gas (2023) || Industries: electricity, gas, water; food, beverages, tobacco; machinery and equipment, automotive parts, base metals, chemical products, coke, refined petroleum, nuclear fuel; outsourcing centers
